{{Icon|Haste icon|'''Haste'''}} is a type of buff applied to operators in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

When operators are affected by '''Haste''', they temporarily have increased movement speed. The number represents the degree of the speed increase.

Despite the tooltip stating that Haste can stack, multiple sources of Haste <u>do not stack</u>. Instead, only the most recently applied source takes effect. An operator's movement speed increase from Haste is capped at {{Color|30%|1d}}.
